visual.general_description: Two-series line graph of hemoglobin and indirect bilirubin against day after hospitalization with surgery, vancomycin, transfusion and death annotations.
visual.detailed_description: White-background two-series line graph. The x axis is labelled Day after hospitalization with ticks 0 to 18; the y axis is labelled Laboratory results with ticks 0 to 180 in steps of 20. Circle markers joined by a line (legend: Hemoglobin (g/L)) are labelled 163 at day 1, 134 at day 7, 109 at day 10, 95 at day 12, 83 at day 15 and 44 at day 17, a steadily falling series. Square markers joined by a line (legend: Indirect bilirubin (μmol/L)) are labelled 5.3 at day 1, 4.8 at day 10, 4.4 at day 12, 8.0 at day 15 and 131.4 at day 17, near the baseline until a steep rise after day 15. A horizontal bar labelled Vancomycin administration spans from about day 9 to about day 16 to 17 above the plot. A downward arrow labelled Surgery points at about day 9, a downward arrow labelled Transfusion points at day 17, and a downward arrow labelled Death points at about day 18. No patient names, identifiers, dates or panel letters are visible.
